question: Which of the following in an oncogene whose transcription product is a membrane receptor with tyrosine kinase activity of a growth factor?
analysis: HER2/neu is an oncogene that encodes a membrane receptor with intrinsic tyrosine kinase activity. It is part of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) family and is involved in the regulation of cell growth and differentiation. Overexpression or amplification of HER2/neu is associated with certain types of cancers, particularly breast cancer.
